com.github.miachm.sods

Class ChartGraphicProperties

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.github.miachm.sods.ChartGraphicProperties

  • public class ChartGraphicProperties
extends java.lang.Object
    Holds graphic properties for chart elements. These properties control strokes, fills, and other shape-related settings used when serializing chart styles.

    • Method Detail

      • getStroke

        public java.lang.String getStroke()
        Returns the stroke style. This corresponds to the line style used for borders or outlines in the chart graphic elements.
        Returns:
        The stroke style.

      • getFill

        public java.lang.String getFill()
        Returns the fill style. This corresponds to the fill pattern or mode used for chart shapes.
        Returns:
        The fill style.

      • getStrokeWidth

        public java.lang.String getStrokeWidth()
        Returns the stroke width. This is stored as a size value in the document (for example, "0.03cm").
        Returns:
        The stroke width.

      • getStrokeColor

        public Color getStrokeColor()
        Returns the stroke color. The color affects outlines of chart elements.
        Returns:
        The stroke color.

      • getFillColor

        public Color getFillColor()
        Returns the fill color. The color affects the interior of chart elements.
        Returns:
        The fill color.

      • getEdgeRounding

        public java.lang.String getEdgeRounding()
        Returns the edge rounding value. This controls how rounded the corners of chart elements appear.
        Returns:
        The edge rounding value.

      • setStroke

        public void setStroke(java.lang.String stroke)
        Sets the stroke style. This controls the line style used for outlines in the chart.
        Parameters:
        stroke - The stroke style.

      • setFill

        public void setFill(java.lang.String fill)
        Sets the fill style. This controls how shapes are filled (solid, patterned, etc.).
        Parameters:
        fill - The fill style.

      • setStrokeWidth

        public void setStrokeWidth(java.lang.String strokeWidth)
        Sets the stroke width. The value is stored as a size string in the document.
        Parameters:
        strokeWidth - The stroke width.

      • setStrokeColor

        public void setStrokeColor(Color strokeColor)
        Sets the stroke color. This color is used for outlines of chart elements.
        Parameters:
        strokeColor - The stroke color.

      • setFillColor

        public void setFillColor(Color fillColor)
        Sets the fill color. This color is used for the interior of chart elements.
        Parameters:
        fillColor - The fill color.

      • setEdgeRounding

        public void setEdgeRounding(java.lang.String edgeRounding)
